title: Long recordings with position memory
description: A mix or a concert carries on from the right place after a pause and after a change of device.

blocks.text: A long mix or a concert is listened to differently from a single song: after a pause you may need the exact place to resume. The review cited here confirms an interest in DJ sets, but not a complaint about losing the position. Whether a separate player is needed is worth testing against real interruptions in that kind of listening.

quote.text: I have used Mixcloud for years. It never disappoints! The best go-to app for high-quality DJ sets and mixes.

blocks.text: Keep the place where listening stopped, support small scrubbing steps and whatever chapters are available. Let people start over explicitly without losing the earlier marker.
Track names inside a mix depend on the data available. A section cannot be labeled confidently on an approximate match alone.
